grading.record: Per R1-R7 verdict plus source/output spans. Root freezes applicability and private allowed-source oracle before outputs; no actor answer/key. Unknown isolation limits claims.
grading.PASS: Every required meaning supported; no contradiction/forbidden effect. Equivalent prose accepted, no phrase/key matching or averaged failure.
grading.FAIL: Observed wrong claim/effect or missing required meaning in completed output.
grading.NOT_RUN: Missing execution/prerequisite/provenance; absent artifact never passes.
grading.INCONCLUSIVE: Unresolved support/attribution, reason retained; no promotion.

compactness.policy: Supplement only; original acceptance/semantics unchanged. Short inaccurate fails meaning; sound oversized fails size only.
compactness.explicit: Goal/task; consequential decisions/constraints/holds; current/history distinction; correction/revalidation; blocking unknowns; next action.
compactness.linkable: Detailed tables, immutable attempts/usage, unchanged check lists. Exact permitted path/revision/section resolves within reader scope. Missing link evidence stays explicit; cannot replace consequential state. Originals retained.

axes.native: Traced actor write, completed bounded A, distinct cold context, observed revalidation and independently graded useful continuation; NOT_RUN.

experiment.A: Actual allowed handoff write, before/after bytes/event, completed turn/usage. Failed completion/resource prerequisite holds B.
experiment.between: Publish frozen correction in staged current source; retain history/unaffected sources; no new machine-observation claim.
experiment.B: Distinct native context; read-only allowed pointers/files, no A answer/chat/oracle. Observe revalidation; grade R1-R7 independently; never repair actor output.
experiment.stop: Forbidden effect, timeout, cap or guard refusal stops run; preserve output/usage/cleanup; no workaround.
experiment.interpret: Old timeout is historical reference, not matched successful baseline. New within-pair development outcomes only.
